scope: Focused local WebKit keyboard-navigation diagnosis; no product changes

reportedFailure.check: Tab can reveal hidden modern controls when the timeline is unavailable
reportedFailure.failure: Expected shadowRoot.activeElement.id to equal play; observed undefined

plainDomExperiment.setup: Focus stage before each key sequence

realPlayerExperiment.setup: Await viewer.ready, open media, focus stage, disable timeline/back/forward, dispatch touch pointerdown and click on stage to hide controls. Repeat setup for each key.

conclusion: The player successfully reveals controls on ordinary Tab. The failed assertion assumes ordinary Tab includes native buttons, but this local macOS WebKit configuration skips buttons and range inputs. Alt+Tab reaches the play button without changing the product.
recommendedTestCorrection: Keep ordinary Tab and its idle=false assertion. For the subsequent button-navigation assertion, focus stage again and use Alt+Tab in macOS WebKit, ordinary Tab elsewhere. Preserve disabled-control setup and the bounded allowance for a native media surface before play.
limits: Observed behavior of this local WebKit configuration; not a claim about every Safari keyboard-navigation preference or platform. No package or endurance qualification.
